before_times: for you, or for your child (a parent or guardian books)
a new problem or after surgery (an evaluation), or a visit from your plan of care
a doctor's referral or prescription for therapy: yes (from whom) or no
a health plan (its name only), Medicare, Medicaid, or paying yourself
from a work injury or a car accident: no, a work injury, or a car accident
days and times that suit you
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like a walker, a wheelchair or needing an interpreter
at home: stairs at the door, where to park, and who will be there
secure_page_only: plan member ID, the plan holder and photos of both sides of the plan card
a photo of the referral, where the state's form or the plan asks for one
the surgery and its date, and the surgeon's office (the clinic asks the surgeon for the protocol itself)
for a work injury or a car accident: the claim number and the adjuster's name
intake_questions.never_asked: which surgery and its details, symptoms, the plan's member ID and the referral itself are never asked in the AI chat: only on the secure page
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who comes to the visit; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules allow it (a switch)

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, or stroke signs (sudden weakness, a drooping face, slurred speech)
after surgery: a hot or swollen calf, a fever, or a red or leaking wound
stop.say: Call your surgeon's office now, or go to an emergency room if it's closed. If your chest hurts or breathing gets hard, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking; the clinic is told, and a booked visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee

stop.words: a fall with a new injury, or a sudden loss of feeling or control
stop.say: Call 911, or go to an emergency room now.

go_on.words: pain or stiffness with nothing else
go_on.what: matched to an evaluation; Rosie never judges how serious anything is

go_on.words: a fall with no new injury (someone fell, and isn't hurt)
go_on.what: the safety words first: if they fall and can't get up, or hit their head, call 911; then the booking goes on, marked urgent

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988; the owner can add the clinic's own after-surgery words at sign-up

steps.name: The referral
steps.when: asked before the times; a photo on the secure page
steps.who: every new patient, where the state's form or the plan needs one (a switch)
steps.result: no referral where the state allows a first visit without one: booked and marked 'no referral', with only therapists the state allows; where the state or the plan needs one and there's none: the patient gets one from a doctor first, and nothing is booked

steps.name: Health history, consent and the plan's papers
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk or door first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The surgeon's protocol and surgery notes
steps.who: a patient after surgery: the clinic asks the surgeon's office itself
steps.result: a to-do for the desk; records go office to office, never through Rosie; late: the therapist calls the surgeon's office on the day

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent on time, as the federal rules say
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: The plan's OK for the visits after the evaluation
steps.when: after the evaluation, asked by the desk on the plan's own website
steps.who: patients whose plan asks for it
steps.result: approved: the series is booked within the approved visits and dates; pending: only the next visit is booked; denied: self-pay, or stop

first_steps_and_forms.prep: come 15 minutes early to the first visit; bring a photo ID, the plan card, and a walker or cane if you use one; wear shorts or loose clothes

staff.skills: physical therapists: evaluations, progress re-checks, the plan of care, and every visit; assistants: follow-up visits only, under a therapist's plan of care; dry needling only by a therapist trained for it; only people cleared for home visits go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each physical therapist's and each assistant's own license, per state; an athletic trainer's own license for athletic training
staff.supervision: an assistant works only under a physical therapist's plan of care, with the supervision the state's form sets (a switch: on site, or reachable by phone)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day times, any custom price (at the clinic, every one; at home, over $500), and anything a therapist flags
staff.stand_in: an evaluation or a re-check: only another physical therapist; a follow-up: a therapist, or an assistant under the same plan

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who comes to the visit; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules allow it (a switch)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk; at home: the code at the door, from the patient or the family member named on the booking
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the evaluation, the plan of care and the visit notes stay in the clinic's own records, never in Rosie or a text; the clinic sends the plan and progress notes to the doctor itself
visit.changes_at_visit: the evaluation sets the plan of care: goals, how many visits a week, for how many weeks, and home exercises; taping or dry needling only with the patient's yes and its price first
visit.before_work: the therapist reads the health history, the referral and the surgeon's protocol before starting

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each physical therapist and each physical therapist assistant holds their own active license from the state's physical therapy board
license.who: each person; the practice too, where the state's form registers physical therapy practices or their owners (a switch)
license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration number from the owner, where the state's form asks for one
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the surgery, the plan, the reason, the results or the therapist's name at the clinic (at home, the therapist's name stays, for the door check)
